name: Tolerance
definition: Variance allowed on a quantity or on a price.

PlusPercent.name: Plus Percent
PlusPercent.definition: Variance in percentage allowed over the agreed dimension. For example, plus 10 percent.

MinusPercent.name: Minus Percent
MinusPercent.definition: Variance in percentage allowed below the agreed dimension. For example, minus 10 percent.

RelatedUndertakingAmount.name: Related Undertaking Amount
RelatedUndertakingAmount.definition: Undertaking amount for which a tolerance is provided.

Quantity.name: Quantity
Quantity.definition: Quantity of product on which a tolerance is allowed.

Price.name: Price
Price.definition: Price on which a tolerance is allowed.
